h1: Retargeting Video Ad for Shoppers Who Already Looked
lead: Give shoppers who already saw the product a closer look. You choose the audience, and you type the offer.
steps_h2: How to Make a Retargeting Video Ad in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: One closer detail, a voice if you want one, and the offer typed by you.

steps.d: Upload one photo of the detail worth a second look, or paste a product page link.
Describe one closer look, pick a voice and captions, then choose a size and a length.
Download the clip, type the offer yourself, and choose the audience in your ad platform.

faq.q: What is a retargeting video ad?
faq.a: A new product clip for people who already saw an item. It can run as a cart reminder, but the file has no viewer list. You choose who sees it, who to leave out, and how often, in your ad platform.

faq.q: Does AIVideosUGC know who viewed a product or left a cart?
faq.a: No. The clip does not receive browsing or cart data. You choose the audience in your ad platform, and the scene only shows the product.

faq.q: How do I make a retargeting video ad?
faq.a: Upload a photo or paste a product page link, describe one closer look, pick a voice and a length, then download. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: Which shops use a retargeting video ad?
faq.a: Electronics, fashion, and other shops that show ads again to people who already visited on Facebook or Instagram. Use it when you need a new video, not a repeat of the first ad.
One detail the first view may have missed: a lid, a zipper, a finish, or a daily-use moment. Keep the product as the subject.

faq.q: Which size and length should I pick?
faq.a: Square 1:1 for a feed and tall 9:16 for Reels are the usual pair, plus a wide 16:9. 4:3 and 3:4 are there too. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: Can I put the current offer on the video?
faq.a: Type the confirmed price, date, or code yourself. A spoken line can describe the product, and you keep the numbers under your control if the offer changes.

faq.q: Can the clip include a voice, captions, and an actor?
faq.a: Yes. Add a script, a voice, captions, music, and an AI actor while you make this clip. The person on camera is generated, not a past buyer.

faq.q: Can I make several versions or use the API?
faq.a: Yes. Make more than one closer look from the same photo, in more than one language, or start the job from your own software (API). Each version spends credits (points on your plan).
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. You see the cost first. A failed job returns its credits. Starter is $24.50 a month.
Publish to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook from here, or download it for an ad aimed at people who already looked. The file has no watermark.

more_sections.lead: The video can include a voice and captions. You still choose who sees it in your ad platform.

items.d: Pick a voice for the spoken line, or copy a voice you are allowed to use. The line can say the product name while the picture shows it.
Captions can sit with the spoken line so the point is readable while the clip plays. You can edit the wording before you publish.
Describe the shot in a sentence. A draft turns that into the line an actor says, and you can rewrite it before the video is made.
Browse [AI actors](page:ai-actors) and pick someone to hold or point at the product. You can use that same person in the next clip. The person is generated, not a customer.
Trim in the built-in editor, add a track from the music library, and make the same clip again in another language.
